恢复需在服务器上离线执行，Docker 镜像已内置恢复命令，无需安装 Pytho: Restore offline on the server. The Docker image includes the restore command; Python is not required. Direct restoration from this page is not available.

停止原服务，按部署文档执行 fiftyapi restore，将备份恢复到新目录: Stop the original service and follow the deployment guide to run fiftyapi restore into a new directory. The command validates the backup, master key and database version, preserving the original database.
将数据库路径切换到恢复目录后启动，检查用户、Key、预算、备份计划和上游授权。快: Switch the database path to the restored directory and start the service. Check users, API keys, budgets, backup schedules and upstream authorization. Changes after the snapshot are not restored; rotated OAuth tokens may require reauthorization.
